primary: Held-out targets and required regressions passing in pristine production-only reconstruction; completion status separate
budgetPolicy: Reserve an entire four-arm task/repetition round before dispatch. Equal common token/wall/tool limits; dollar ceilings differ by model price and binding ceilings are explicitly censored.
replacementPolicy: No automatic reruns. Stop on provider, configuration or evaluator failure, preserve all data and require an explicit documented protocol amendment before any replacement.
uncertainty: Paired comparisons B-A, C-A, C-B, C-D; task-cluster resampling of complete four-arm rounds with both repetitions, report family/category coverage and missingness. Ties do not demonstrate equivalence.
taskGatePolicy: Immutable validation receipt before first inference on each task; additional environments may be prepared between completed balanced rounds. No primary-result-based prompt or controller tuning.
exclusions: Public benchmark contamination possible; repository family and task repetitions are correlated; native platform adaptation; estimated prices are not invoices; model/effort comparison includes Sol Medium vs Luna xhigh.
